I will not buy chemical fertilizer for this small plot. One bag costs too much money and the agro-dealer in town is far away, so I cannot afford it. I will put cow dung on the plot instead, because I have animals and this land is mine, and I want to keep the soil good. I will plant the white maize seed I saved from last year — it grows even when the rain comes late, and I do not trust those new seeds that need chemicals.
